sources.strengths: EN 1998-3 Sec 3.5 and Table 4.3 (mean values from tests, divided by CF; brittle also by the partial factors)
sources.hazards: EN 1998-3 Sec 2.1(2)P-(4)P Notes (DL 225 years, SD 475 years, NC 2475 years); spectrum scales by EN 1998-1 Sec 2.1(4) Note with k = 3

knowledge.label: KL1: limited knowledge
knowledge.note: EN 1998-3 Table 3.1: lateral force or modal response spectrum analysis only.

hazards.label: SD: 10 % in 50 years (475 years, the design earthquake)

linear.note: The seismic forces of the analysis (the design forces with q and γI) are made the elastic forces of the limit state's return period: × q/γI × the hazard's spectrum scale. Ductile members: the chord rotation θ = (M/My)·θy of the secant stiffness to yield against θy (DL), 3/4 θum (SD) and θum (NC), with the strengths of the deformation use (mean/CF) and γel = 1.5 of primary members. Brittle actions: the shear against VR of Eq A.12. φy = 2.1 εy/h of a rectangular section stands for the section's yield curvature (SAEngine practice). ψ2 = 0.3 (offices) for the live load (SAEngine practice; a project with another use overrides linear.liveShare).

nonlinear.note: The EN 1998-3 hinges of the pushover table: θum with the strengths divided by CF, and the hinges' shear against VR of Eq A.12 with the plastic ductility at the target.

shear.note: z = 0.9 d; x (the compression zone depth) from the section's strain compatibility at the axial force.

jacketing.note: EN 1998-3 A.4.2.2: the jacketed member as a monolithic one with the jacket's concrete over the whole section, the old bars where they are.

frp.note: EN 1998-3 gives no environmental factors: 1.0 (a project overrides them). Full wraps: ff,e = Ef·εfe with εfe = 0.004 at most half the rupture strain (SAEngine practice for the debonding-free full wrap of A.4.4.2). Flexural strengthening with FRP is not covered by this pack.

note: EN 1998-3:2005 with the recommended values of its Notes (the national annex may change them, as a project override). EN 1998-3 has no screening checklist.
